title: Cleaning and Damage Fees Market Add-On for Moved-Down Cleaning Fees
content:
The fee assessed on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report that is moved down at review carries a metro add-on read from the market the reported trip started in: Denver, Las Vegas and Salt Lake City carry the high-cost metro add-on; Colorado Springs, Phoenix and Tucson carry the mid-cost metro add-on; any other market carries no metro add-on.

The market is the one shown on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) as the metro market the trip started in.

| Market the trip started in | Code on the trip record | Metro add-on |
|---|---|---|
| Denver | DEN | $15.00 (high-cost) |
| Las Vegas | LAS | $15.00 (high-cost) |
| Salt Lake City | SLC | $15.00 (high-cost) |
| Colorado Springs | COS | $8.00 (mid-cost) |
| Phoenix | PHX | $8.00 (mid-cost) |
| Tucson | TUS | $8.00 (mid-cost) |
| Albuquerque, or any other market | ABQ or other | none |

The add-on is a fixed dollar amount added to the fee assessed at the moved-down level.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** Two identical reports are moved down to the same level, one on a trip that started in Salt Lake City and one on a trip that started in Tucson. The first carries a $15.00 metro add-on and the second an $8.00 metro add-on; a third report on a trip that started in Albuquerque carries none.
